-> Limit: 20 row(s)  (cost=0.7 rows=1)
    -> Nested loop inner join  (cost=0.7 rows=1)
        -> Sort: o.total DESC  (cost=0.35 rows=1)
            -> Filter: ((o.`status` = 'open') and (o.customer_id is not null))  (cost=0.35 rows=1)
                -> Table scan on o  (cost=0.35 rows=1)
        -> Single-row index lookup on c using PRIMARY (id=o.customer_id)  (cost=0.35 rows=1)
